summary: Iteration 7 (modular router refactor + hybrid price comparison + expanded preferences) fully verified. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_7_refactor_compare.py = 33/33 pass; full regression suite (iteration_4 + iteration_5 + iteration_6) = 44/44 pass → zero API regressions from the server.py → routes/* + core/* refactor. NEW /api/products/compare verified per category: food (8901030895001) → Amazon India/Flipkart/Blinkit/Zepto (no Nykaa/1mg/HealthKart); supplement (8908001234567) → Amazon/Flipkart/Tata 1mg/HealthKart; personal_care (8906087771204) → Amazon/Flipkart/Blinkit/Zepto/Nykaa; unknown barcode → 404; live_enabled=false and products[] empty as expected with placeholder provider keys. ui_bugs.issue: After tapping 'Save changes', a red error toast 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' appears when /preferences is opened as the first screen (web deep link has no back stack). On in-app navigation (profile → preferences) back works, but consider router.canGoBack() guard with fallback to profile tab. Reference: app/preferences.tsx

action_items: Optional: guard router.back() after preferences save (check canGoBack or router.replace to /profile) to avoid GO_BACK toast on direct web entry.
No other fixes required — refactor is behavior-identical, compare endpoint and new preferences fully working.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/products.py lookup correctly keeps guest/registered scan accounting, region-free country logic, history insert and watchlist notify — identical behavior to pre-refactor monolith (44/44 legacy regression tests green).

price_comparison.py compare_for never lets provider failures break the app (try/except + gather return_exceptions); deep_links are pure string formatting and always available. Mongo price_cache with 15-min TTL only used when keys configured — correct for the disabled-live state.
routes/admin.py admin/users masks emails (email_masked) and excludes admin accounts — my initial test assumed raw email; updated test asserts masked shape. Not a regression.
promocodes/preview raises 400 for invalid codes via apply_promo (by design, matches /promocodes/{code} lookup rules); test updated to assert this. Not a regression.
server.py is now a slim app factory (~73 lines) — previous 1653-line size issue resolved by the refactor.
Deprecated packages: none found in changed code (price-comparison.tsx uses expo-vector-icons + Linking only).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (product page compare UI + deep-link tap + preferences options all verified on mobile viewport)
